description: This file contains template metaprogramming utilities used for batching rules in the PyTorch functorch library, including typelist manipulations, type traits, and conversion helpers for batching functions.

classes.name: tail
classes.description: Metaprogramming struct to obtain the tail of a typelist.

classes.name: IfFirstIsTensorAndSecondisBatchDimThenTailElseNext
classes.description: Template struct to select type based on whether the first type is a tensor and the second is a batch dimension.

classes.name: RemoveBatchDimAfterTensor
classes.description: Metaprogram to remove batch dimension annotations after tensor types in a typelist.

classes.name: UnpackSingleItemTuple
classes.description: Type trait to unpack a single-item tuple into its element type.

classes.name: BuildFunctionHelper
classes.description: Helper to construct function types from return and argument types.

classes.name: BuildFunction
classes.description: Constructs a function type from a return type and a typelist of argument types.

classes.name: ToOperatorType
classes.description: Converts a batch rule function type into an operator function type by removing batch dims and unpacking return types.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Returns the typelist without its first element.

methods.name: IfFirstIsTensorAndSecondisBatchDimThenTailElseNext
methods.description: Selects type based on tensor and batch dimension conditions.

methods.name: RemoveBatchDimAfterTensor
methods.description: Removes batch dimension annotations following tensor types in a typelist.

methods.name: UnpackSingleItemTuple
methods.description: Unpacks a tuple with a single item into that item.

methods.name: BuildFunctionHelper
methods.description: Helper to build function types from return and argument typelists.

methods.name: BuildFunction
methods.description: Creates a function type from a return type and a typelist of argument types.

methods.name: ToOperatorType
methods.description: Transforms a batch rule function type into an operator function type suitable for use in the system.
